```{r}
read.csv("cfboffense2000.csv")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

column_names <- c(
  "rank", "school", "games", "points_per_game",
  "passing_completions", "passing_attempts",
  "passing_pct", "passing_yards", "passing_td",
  "rushing_attempts", "rushing_yards",
  "rushing_average", "rushing_td",
  "total_plays", "total_yards", "yards_per_play",
  "first_downs_pass", "first_downs_rush",
  "first_downs_penalty", "first_downs_total",
  "penalties", "penalty_yards",
  "fumbles_lost", "interceptions", "turnovers"
)

# Work from either the repository root or this document's project folder.
data_dir <- if (dir.exists("project")) "project" else "."
files <- list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  # The 2024 export is CSV-formatted but has a .txt extension.
  pattern = "^cfboffense[0-9]{4}\\.(csv|txt)$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No cfboffense files found. Run from the repository root or project folder.")
}

# Import every file and combine into one dataframe
offense_all <- files |>
  map(\(file) {
    read_csv(
      file,
      skip = 2,
      col_names = column_names,
      col_types = cols(.default = col_double(), school = col_character()),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ) |>
      mutate(
        year = as.integer(str_extract(basename(file), "[0-9]{4}"))
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

offense_all |>
  count(year)
```

```{r}
offense_with_coaches <- Coaches_Data |> inner_join(offense_all, join_by(School == school, Year == year))
```


#Goal: find means of select stats
```{r}
offense_with_coaches %>%
  summarize(across(c(rank, points_per_game, passing_yards, rushing_yards, total_yards, first_downs_total), 
                   ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
```
# Goal: getting z-scores. I'm unsure how I would get z-scores on the numbers relative to the rest of the teams that year, or if that's what I would even need to do. I think I just calculated z-scores based on distance from the mean of all the Saban-tree coaches.
```{r}
offense_with_coaches <- offense_with_coaches |>
  mutate(across(
    c(rank, points_per_game, passing_yards, rushing_yards, total_yards, first_downs_total),
    ~ (.x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .names = "{.col}_zscore"
  ))
```
